Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: Which person types and work relationship types Vanderbilt uses (Employee, Nonworker, Contingent Worker, Pending Worker) and what each means for pay; Whether 'work unit' is the on-screen label for department at Vanderbilt; Vanderbilt's employment model (single vs. multiple assignments) and legal employer name(s).

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Oracle HCM stores every person inside a set of structures: who legally employs them, which unit they belong to, what job and position they hold, and how they are paid.

Knowing these terms makes every other course easier, because each transaction you submit changes one or more of them.

Use this whenYou are new to Oracle HCM, or a screen uses a term (legal employer, work relationship, assignment) you are not sure about.

2 · Walk through

How the pieces fit.

Check off each item as you read.

Terms at a glance
TermWhat it means for you
Legal employerWho legally employs the person
Business unit / departmentWhere the person sits and is costed by default
Job vs. positionGeneric role vs. a specific seat in a department
Work relationshipThe employment link to a legal employer
AssignmentWhere job, pay, hours, and manager live

Watch-outs

  • Changes to a position can flow into every incumbent's assignment. Know which fields the position controls before you edit an assignment.
  • Do not reuse or repurpose a position for a different worker type; ask Compensation instead.
  • Open item: confirm which person types and work relationship types Vanderbilt uses and what each one means for pay.

HCM Academy job aid · Start Here

HCM Structure and Key Concepts

Use when: You are new to Oracle HCM, or a screen uses a term (legal employer, work relationship, assignment) you are not sure about. · System: Overview

  1. Start at the top: the enterprise and the legal employer.
  2. Know your business unit and department (work unit).
    • Department is often called a work unit at Vanderbilt and in reports.
  3. Tell a job from a position.
    • Vanderbilt jobs use six-digit job codes (job architecture).
  4. Understand the grade.
  5. Read the employment model: person, work relationship, assignment.
    • A person has only one primary work relationship and one primary assignment in it.
  6. Check the person type before you act.
